Style guide

How this site speaks

Type, colour, spacing and corners, drawn from the tokens the whole site is built on.

Type scale

Every page starts with one clear sentence.

Sections read as a sequence of assertions.

Cards, tabs and dialogs share this size.

The lead paragraph sets the pace: one idea, said once.

Body text carries the argument. It should read at arm's length on a phone and stay calm on a wide screen, with a measure of about seventy characters.

Small text is for metadata, timestamps and helper lines, never for anything the reader must not miss.
